projects.name: Hands Free
projects.subtitle: Offline Voice-Control Android Overlay | Thesis Project (2026)
projects.description: An offline speech-recognition and voice-control accessibility overlay for Android utilizing an on-device fine-tuned Whisper-tiny model deployed through ONNX Runtime.
highlights: Performed QA testing on most app features and reported results from a 15-participant usability study (450 task attempts), including a System Usability Scale (SUS) score of 76.0.

Analyzed word error rate (WER) against task success rate across three failure modes, documenting the end-to-end CRISP-DM methodology for a fine-tuned Whisper-tiny model deployed offline via ONNX Runtime.
Organized survey responses, WER results, and task attempts into a Results table, authoring the Results, Discussion, Conclusion, and Recommendations sections of the ACM-format manuscript.
